about: Effects for stat text the parser cannot model (R6), keyed by uniqueName (`#<perk>` for Incarnon perks, `#zoom` for a sniper's zoom bonus). `effects` (domain Effect fields) replace the parsed ones and set support to full unless `support` is given; `support` + `note` alone only adjust the status. Values come from the entry's own DE text or a saved wiki page named in `note`; never guessed. Refresh fails on an entry that matches nothing.

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Zariman/Pistols/Hea.note: Laetum page, EVO5: '50% chance to deal +2000% damage on non-critical hits'; notes: multiplicative to base damage bonuses
Laetum page, EVO5: 'On Hit that is neither Critical nor applies a Status Effect: +400% damage for 10 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times'; notes: additive to base damage bonuses

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/TennoSniperRi.note: Incarnon_Evolutions, Vectis Deadhead: '+25% Headshot Damage'; the notes line (additive with Target Acquired and the scope bonus) is how it stacks, not another stat

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/PrimeVecti.note: Incarnon_Evolutions, Vectis Deadhead: '+25% Headshot Damage'; the notes line (additive with Target Acquired and the scope bonus) is how it stacks, not another stat

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Zariman/LongGuns/Se.note: Phenmor page, EVO5: 'On 2 headshots within 2 seconds: +50% Headshot damage for 8 seconds'; notes: additive with Primary Deadhead's headshot bonus

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/Railgun#z.note: Lanka page: 'The zoom bonus adds a flat +20/30/50 critical chance, applied after mods' (8x zoom: +50)

unparsed: +100% Damage, +3.5m Explosion Radius, -75% Fire Rate (3.5x zoom)
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpSentAm.note: Sniper_Rifle: Komorex zoom bonuses are an exception to the additive rule; not applied until the Komorex page is saved
